method: Same deterministic 400000-message synthetic unencrypted fixture; 30 authors, 390 UTC days, 40000-word vocabulary, reverse timestamp arrivals.
Production Core channel client after all rollups settle. First call has empty activation-local projection and publication caches. OS page cache is not flushed.

Warm median uses five identical queries. Three fresh disposable test-host activations reuse durable rollups, wait clean and prewarm the helper with SELECT 1, then query every section and variant once.
Only the synthetic test host restarts. No running-app attachment, restart or real-profile measurement.
External CPU and disk load are uncontrolled. Dependency restoration overlapped this after run. Before and after are not a controlled throughput comparison.

residuals: The 100 ms cold budget is not met by all sections or Words variants. Issue #319 remains open.
Counts still process packed daily identity/calendar histories; Words still decodes vocabulary prefixes and tokenizes partial UTC boundary days.
Person-filtered Words uses per-author daily packets. Canonical Unicode trend ties retain the exact legacy ordering scan on a clean snapshot.
Calendar/selected-term series output and full-channel background index rebuilds grow with history. Multi-channel, dense-day and encrypted live-archive latency is not established.
